manifest.name: dsh-ssh-remote
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness SSH remote workspaces powered by system OpenSSH and a versioned Python helper.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/build-client.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh-ssh-remote profile bundle patch (declared by `dsh.bundle.patch`).
# Inserts the SSH remote workspaces plugin row into any profile that lists
# `dsh-ssh-remote` in its `dsh.profile.bundles`. The row loads the plugin by
# package name from the profile's node_modules, so it survives dsh upgrades.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-ssh-remote
      name: 'dsh-ssh-remote'
      config: {}

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) · [下载 0.13.3](https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/tag/v0.13.3) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [排错](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

**远程开发，像在本地一样顺手。**

在 DeepSeek Harness 中打开 SSH 工作区，用原生文件面板和终端开发。复用 `~/.ssh/config`，支持远程编辑、`@` 文件引用、端口转发和文件传输，无需在服务器运行完整 DSH。
已有可用的 **DSH** 和 **SSH 别名**？直接从这里开始。Desktop 自带运行时，不必额外安装 Node。

1. 打开左侧 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴下面的完整地址。
2. 点击 **安装 → 立即启用**。首次安装或从 0.11.x 升级后，保存工作并完整重启当前 DSH；日后按更新结果提示操作。
3. 点击 **添加工作区**，选择 SSH 主机与远端文件夹，即可使用官方 **工作区文件** 和 **新建终端**。

~~~text
https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.3/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.3.tgz
~~~

无需克隆、编译或复制插件目录。安装器仍需联网下载运行依赖。

插件详情中的 **开始使用** 可随时展开查看连接步骤；界面跟随 DSH 的中文／英文设置，不另设语言开关。已有 0.12.0 的用户可直接在插件详情检查更新。

> **请使用完整地址。** npm 上同名的 `dsh-ssh-remote` 属于其他项目。Desktop 与 Web 使用独立 profile，需分别安装。

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.3/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.3.tgz'
~~~

安装后重新启动 `dsh web`；已有服务先在它的终端按 Ctrl-C。**Desktop 请使用应用自己的插件页。**

<details>
<summary>其他安装方式与安装界面</summary>

固定 Git Tag（需要本机 Git）：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote#v0.13.3'
~~~

也可下载 Release 的 `.tgz`，在插件页输入其绝对路径；`SHA256SUMS` 用于校验下载包。遇到依赖脚本提示时按官方安装器确认，不要全局放开未知脚本。0.11.0 起已移除 `ssh2` / `cpu-features` 原生构建依赖。

</details>

| 日常操作 | 入口 |
| --- | --- |
| 浏览、预览文件 | 官方侧栏 **工作区文件** |
| 编辑并保存文本 | 文件页签菜单 **编辑远程文本**，或快速打开中的 **编辑** |
| 找到并引用代码 | **SSH · 主机 → 快速打开**，或输入框中的原生 `@` |
| 运行命令 | 官方侧栏 **新建终端** |
| 查看目录、命令退出码与上下文 | 终端页签菜单 **查看 SSH 终端状态** |
| 访问 TensorBoard、Jupyter、开发网页 | **远程工作台 → 端口转发** |
| 上传、下载文件或目录 | **远程工作台 → 文件传输** |
| 使用远端 skill | 当前远程会话的原生 `/` 技能菜单 |

顶部 **SSH · 主机** 打开统一远程工作台；空会话入口在输入框上方。本地会话仍使用原来的文件和终端，不会被接管。

连接圆点：绿＝SSH/helper 已连接，黄＝连接中或能力受限，灰色空心＝未连接或状态未知，红＝连接错误。悬停或键盘聚焦可查看完整路径和原因。绿点不代表所有远端功能都已经验证。

先按 [DSH 官方说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)安装 DSH，再准备本机 OpenSSH 别名：

~~~sshconfig
Host devbox
  HostName your-server.example.com
  User your-user
~~~

运行 `ssh devbox`，首次连接时核对主机指纹，确认能登录后 `exit`。插件后台使用非交互认证，因此还需确认：

~~~sh
ssh -o BatchMode=yes devbox true
~~~

随后按上面的三步安装连接，在原生终端运行 `pwd` 验证远端目录，无需发送模型消息。首次连接会部署匹配的 Python helper；主机诊断位于 **设置 → 内置插件 → SSH Remote**。自定义 `Port`、`IdentityFile`、`ProxyJump` 仍写在 OpenSSH 配置中，不必在插件里重复填写。

兼容验收覆盖 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3**；结果以对应 Release 的验收记录为准，不自动切换 DSH 更新通道。

| 用途 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| Desktop | 官方 DSH Desktop，自带 Node 和包管理器 |
| CLI / Web | Node 22+，`dsh` 与 `pnpm` 可用 |
| 基础远程连接 | 本机 OpenSSH、可用的非交互认证；远端 Python 3.8+ |
| 文件搜索与 `@` 补全 | 远端 ripgrep；Git 工作区索引还需要 Git |
| 模型受限命令执行 | 远端 Linux 和 bubblewrap；浏览文件、人工终端不要求它 |
| 远端 `run_code` / PTC | 远端 Node 22.13+（须支持 `stripTypeScriptTypes`）；受限权限仍需 bubblewrap。Desktop 自带 Node 不等于远端已有 Node |

- 文本编辑：完整 UTF-8 文件，最大 **256 KiB**；重启前保存草稿。
- 文件传输：单文件、单批上限 **1 TiB**；小样本实测、容量边界模拟，未测试 TB 级吞吐。重启续传需重新授权源或目标目录。
- 端口转发：目前仅验收 macOS / Linux 本机；Windows 尚无完整 Desktop/SSH 验收。
- 远端技能：默认发现项目及用户的 `.dsh/skills`、`.agents/skills`，不跟随符号链接、不自动执行脚本。
- DSH 的 Finder / 本机应用入口仍是本机操作；远端文件使用面板预览和远程编辑。

详细范围见[技术参考](docs/TECHNICAL.md)。从旧 SFTP/插件 host 配置迁移见[迁移指南](docs/MIGRATION-0.11.md)；已有 OpenSSH 别名无需迁移，升级不会自动改写 SSH 配置。

**应用内更新：** 打开 **插件 → dsh-ssh-remote → 检查更新**。发现稳定版后点击 **更新到版本号 → 确认更新**，无需返回仓库或复制新链接。默认在页面可见时每 6 小时检查一次；可在同页关闭自动检查，手动检查仍可用。提醒只显示一次，不自动安装。

网络检查失败后，页面可见时约 5 分钟自动复查；展开“更新排错建议”可查看失败阶段和脱敏错误码。不会擅自切换代理、关闭证书校验或反复安装。

更新调用 DSH 官方安装服务，保留依赖审批与兼容性检查。安装完成与新版生效会分别显示；若提示需要重启，请先保存草稿、暂停传输。**更新重载可能结束 SSH 终端和端口转发；插件不会自动重启 DSH。** 断线或响应丢失时选择 **重新确认结果**，不会自动重复安装。

“检查更新”也会刷新本机安装状态。若旧请求已不在当前 DSH 中，重新核对版本后可点 **结束这次提示**；它只清理提示，不代表安装已取消。之后如仍需更新，再由你确认发起。安装错误的短说明和日志路径放在详情里，长日志不会塞进浏览器恢复记录。

源码 `link:` / 本地目录安装只提示版本，使用 Git 同步，不会被安装包覆盖。0.11.2 及更早版本尚无此入口，需要先按上方步骤安装当前版本。也可随时从 [Releases](https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases) 手动选择固定版本；若 DSH 拒绝直接替换某种来源，按官方插件页提示处理，不自动卸载旧版。Web CLI 仍可在同一 profile 再次运行 `add`。

**回退到 0.13.2：** 在插件页安装上一正式版本，或使用：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.2/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.2.tgz'
~~~

按提示重启，已迁移的 OpenSSH 配置保留。**0.13.0 及更早版本没有本版的控制连接认证修复；回退仅用于隔离排障，不应作为安全等价版本长期使用。**

**停用 / 卸载：** 使用对应应用的插件页。Web 也可停止服务后运行：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ssh-remote
~~~

不会删除远端项目、本地会话或 SSH 配置。已有远程工作区需要插件才能访问，重新安装可复用保存的映射。

[排错指南](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [提交 Issue](https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/issues) · [技术参考](docs/TECHNICAL.md) · [路线图](docs/ROADMAP.md) · [发布流程](docs/RELEASING.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

反馈时附上插件 / DSH 版本、Desktop 或 Web、安装来源及第一个实际错误；不要提交凭据。

[中文](README.md) · [Download 0.13.3](https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/tag/v0.13.3) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

Open an SSH workspace inside DeepSeek Harness. Browse files and run commands in its native panels, with remote editing, `@` references, port forwarding and file transfers. Reuse `~/.ssh/config`; no full DSH installation is needed on the server.
Already have working **DSH** and an **SSH alias**? Start here. Desktop includes its runtime; you do not need to install Node separately.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in the sidebar and paste the full address below.
2. Choose **Install → Enable now**. Save your work and fully restart DSH after the first install or an upgrade from 0.11.x; follow the reported outcome for later updates.
3. Choose **Add workspace**, select your SSH host and folder, then use native **Workspace files** and **New terminal**.

~~~text
https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.3/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.3.tgz
~~~

No clone, build or manual plugin-directory copying. The installer still downloads runtime dependencies.

Expand **Getting started** in the official plugin details for connection steps. The UI follows DSH's Chinese/English preference, without another language switch. Existing 0.12.0 users can check for updates directly in plugin details.
> **Use the full address.** The npm package named `dsh-ssh-remote` belongs to another project. Desktop and Web have separate profiles and need separate installation.

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.3/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.3.tgz'
~~~

Restart `dsh web` afterwards; stop an existing server with Ctrl-C in its terminal first. **For Desktop, use the application's own Plugins page.**

<details>
<summary>Alternative sources and the install dialog</summary>

Fixed Git tag (requires local Git):

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote#v0.13.3'
~~~

You can also download the release `.tgz` and enter its absolute path in Plugins. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`. Review dependency-script prompts in the official installer, without globally allowing unknown scripts. Version 0.11.0 removed the `ssh2` / `cpu-features` native-build dependencies.

</details>

| Task | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| Browse and preview files | Native **Workspace files / 工作区文件** |
| Edit and save text | File-tab menu **编辑远程文本**, or **编辑** in quick open |
| Find and reference code | **SSH · host → 快速打开**, or native `@` |
| Run commands | Native **New terminal / 新建终端** |
| See cwd, exit status and context | Terminal-tab menu **查看 SSH 终端状态** |
| Access TensorBoard, Jupyter or a dev website | **远程工作台 → 端口转发** |
| Upload/download files and folders | **远程工作台 → 文件传输** |
| Use remote skills | Native `/` skill menu in a remote Session |

The **SSH · host** badge opens the unified workbench; blank Sessions show it above the composer. Local Sessions retain their original file and terminal behavior.

Connection dots: green = SSH/helper connected; amber = connecting or limited; hollow gray = disconnected or unknown; red = connection error. Hover or keyboard-focus for the full path and explanation. Green does not certify every remote feature.

Install DSH using the [official instructions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), then configure a concrete local OpenSSH alias:

~~~sshconfig
Host devbox
  HostName your-server.example.com
  User your-user
~~~

Run `ssh devbox`, verify the host fingerprint on first login, then `exit`. The plugin uses non-interactive authentication, so also check:

~~~sh
ssh -o BatchMode=yes devbox true
~~~

Follow the three installation steps above and run `pwd` in a native terminal to verify the remote directory. No model message is needed. The first connection deploys the matching Python helper; host diagnostics are in **Settings → Built-in plugins → SSH Remote**. Keep custom `Port`, `IdentityFile` and `ProxyJump` settings in OpenSSH, without duplicating them in the plugin.
Compatibility coverage: **0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3**. See each Release's acceptance record; the plugin does not switch your DSH update channel.

| Purpose | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Desktop | Official DSH Desktop, with its bundled Node and package manager |
| CLI / Web | Node 22+, `dsh` and `pnpm` on PATH |
| Basic remote connection | Local OpenSSH and non-interactive authentication; remote Python 3.8+ |
| Search and `@` completion | Remote ripgrep; Git workspace discovery also needs Git |
| Restricted model commands | Remote Linux and bubblewrap; not required for browsing or human terminals |
| Remote `run_code` / PTC | Remote Node 22.13+ with `stripTypeScriptTypes`; restricted execution still requires bubblewrap. Desktop's bundled Node does not install Node on the remote host |

- Editing: complete UTF-8 files, **256 KiB** maximum. Save drafts before restarting.
- Transfers: **1 TiB per file/batch**; small real samples and simulated boundaries tested, not TB-scale throughput. Restart recovery requires source/destination reauthorization.
- Forwarding: currently validated on macOS / Linux hosts. Windows has no full Desktop/SSH acceptance.
- Skills: project and user `.dsh/skills` / `.agents/skills` by default, without following symlinks or automatically running scripts.
- DSH's Finder / local-application actions remain local; use preview and remote editing for SSH files.

See the [technical reference](docs/TECHNICAL.md) for detailed boundaries. Old SFTP/plugin-host configurations have a [migration guide](docs/MIGRATION-0.11.md). Existing OpenSSH aliases need no migration; upgrades never automatically rewrite SSH configuration.

**In-app updates:** open **Plugins → dsh-ssh-remote → 检查更新 (Check for updates)**. Select **更新到… → 确认更新** to install a newer stable release without visiting this repository or copying another link. Automatic checks run every six hours while the page is visible; switch them off on the same page without losing manual checks. A new-version notice appears once and never starts installation by itself.

After a failed check, visible automatic checks resume in about five minutes. Expand troubleshooting for the failed stage and sanitized error code. No proxy switch, certificate bypass or repeated installation is performed.

Package installation uses DSH's official service, including dependency approvals and compatibility checks. Installed and running versions are shown separately. Save drafts and pause transfers first: **reloading the SSH plugin may end its terminals and port forwards. It never automatically restarts DSH.** If a response is lost, choose **重新确认结果** to reconcile the result instead of automatically reinstalling.

Check for updates also refreshes local installation facts. When the old request is no longer active in this DSH host and the current version has been read again, **Dismiss this notice** clears only the notice, not an installation. A new update still needs your confirmation. Short diagnostics and the official log path are available in Details; full logs are not stored in browser recovery records.

Source `link:` / local-directory installs show version information only and must be synchronized with Git; archives never replace them automatically. Version 0.11.2 and earlier need one manual installation of the current release to gain this feature. [Releases](https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases) remain available for manual selection. If DSH refuses to replace a source directly, follow its plugin-page guidance; this feature does not remove the old package first. Web CLI users can still repeat `add` in the same profile.

**Roll back to 0.13.2:** install the previous official release in Plugins, or run:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/CrazyShout/dsh-ssh-remote/releases/download/v0.13.2/dsh-ssh-remote-0.13.2.tgz'
~~~

Restart when requested; migrated OpenSSH settings remain. **Version 0.13.0 and earlier lack this release's control-connection authentication fix. Rollback is for isolated diagnostics, not a security-equivalent long-term alternative.**

**Disable / remove:** use the application's Plugins page. For Web, you can also stop the server and run:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ssh-remote
~~~

Removal does not delete remote projects, local conversations or SSH configuration. Remote workspaces need the plugin to work; reinstalling reuses saved mappings.
